t: This is Novelty Automation, a satirical amusement arcade in Holborn. Every machine here was built by cartoonist and engineer Tim Hunkin, often by hand. You'll find an expressive photo booth, an interactive divorce and a small hadron collider. Three of his machines once appeared at Cabaret Mechanical Theatre in Covent Garden: The Frisker, Test Your Nerve and The Chiropodist. Hunkin is also known for the Channel Four series The Secret Life of Machines, and his work has a distinctive papier-mâché style and an offbeat sense of humour.
